Title: Speek AI: AI Agent That Talks and Guides Users ‍Like a Real Person. | Product Hunt
# Speek AI. ## AI Agent That Talks and Guides Users ‍Like a Real Person. Speek uses voice and an animated mouse to help users on your site, answering questions, guiding them through features, and making buying decisions easy. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Speek AI. Hey, PH community, Today, I'm excited to introduce you to \*\*Speek\*\*—an AI agent that's here to make your website as easy to use as having a helpful friend to guide you through every step. Imagine a friendly assistant that talks to you and shows you exactly where to click, making your journey on a website simple and enjoyable. That's why we built Speek. \*\*Guidance Like a Friend:\*\* Speek doesn't just answer questions; it guides users visually with a moving mouse pointer, so they never feel lost. - \*\*Voice Support:\*\* Speek talks users through processes, boosting their confidence as they navigate your site. - \*\*Easy Setup:\*\* Adding Speek to your site is as simple as a few clicks, and it starts helping users right away. We're excited to see how Speek can make your website as easy as chatting with a knowledgeable friend. Interesting idea, do we need to help AI onboard like pendo or it is just a generic browser agent that guides user on any websites AI has not seen before? I really believe that this is the way of the future for explainer help and customer service. It might seem a bit surprising, but we really think that updates like Siri on the iPhone are going to be game-changers for getting everyone to communicate with AI by voice. @arman\_rocket it's funny now to think that the first cell phones had little keypads on them and yet now we've come to accept it as totally normal that a phone is just a screen I think the leap to experiencing websites through audio will still need some encouragement but it's such a more intuitive way to interact that eventually it will become the precident for sites. The moving mouse pointer and voice support add such a personal touch, making it feel like a real guide is helping you along.
